title: WorkOS Auth: overview film
description: One login for your site and the TYPO3 backend. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 49 seconds: WorkOS Auth for TYPO3 v14. Self-service registration; The same identity for editors; Redirect URIs, ready to copy. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Customers expect to sign in with their company identity. Building single sign-on yourself takes months.
WorkOS Auth adds WorkOS sign-in to the TYPO3 frontend and backend.
New customers create an account with a password, an email code, Google or Microsoft.
Editors use the same identity in the backend. The classic form stays one click away.
The setup assistant lists every redirect URI, each with a copy button.
